Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the investigation to a non-authoritative third-party site (MVOTD) to identify the bird species, relying on page metadata/keywords rather than an official BBC Earth source or direct video verification. This introduced misleading cues (e.g., “macaroni penguin” appearing in keywords) and could directly lead to an incorrect species identification instead of confirming via the authoritative source.
